# ncu-erp-template

> Template app and reference for the NorthCap University (NCU India) student ERP portal:
> log in, then read attendance, timetable, internal marks, exam date sheet, courses and profile.
> Unofficial. Read-only. Use only with your own account.

Read this first if you are an AI assistant building something with this repo.

## Pick one of three ways to get the data

1. **Python, any project**: copy `examples/python/ncu_portal.py` (standard library only).
   `portal = login(user, pw)` then `portal.attendance_summary()`, `portal.attendance_details(code)`,
   `portal.schedule()`, `portal.internal_marks()`, `portal.date_sheet()`, `portal.current_courses()`,
   `portal.profile()`.
2. **JavaScript / Node 18.17+**: `import { PortalClient } from './src/portal/client.js'`, then
   `await client.login(user, pw)` and `client.getAttendanceSummary()`, `getAttendanceDetails(code)`,
   `getSchedule()`, `getInternalMarks()`, `getDateSheet()`, `getCurrentCourses()`, `getBasicDetails()`.
3. **Any language over HTTP**: run `npm start`, then call this app's API at `http://127.0.0.1:3000`.
   `POST /api/login` with `{"username","password"}` returns `{"user", "token"}`. Send
   `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other call (or keep the `ncu_sid` cookie).
   Routes: `/api/attendance`, `/api/attendance/<courseCode>`, `/api/schedule`, `/api/marks`,
   `/api/datesheet`, `/api/courses`, `/api/profile`, `/api/biometric` (campus WiFi only).

## If you call the portal API directly, these three mistakes return no data

Base URL: `https://uatapi.ncuindia.edu/api/`. Login: `POST Authentication/ValidateUser` with
`{"UserName","Password","IpAddress":"","UserType":"STUDENT"}` gives `{token, User:{UserId, Name}}`.
Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every GET.

1. **`userId` is `User.UserId` from the login response, not the roll number.** The roll number
   gives `Succeeded: false` and `Data: null`. `UserId` is opaque and its text differs on every
   login, so use the one returned with the token you are using.
2. **`Data` is a JSON string. Parse it twice.** `body.Data.Table` fails;
   `JSON.parse(body.Data).Table` works. Check `Succeeded` first.
3. **URL-encode `UserId`**. It contains `+`, `/` and `=`.

Attendance summary rows are in `JSON.parse(Data).Table`. The timetable is in
`JSON.parse(Data).Table1`. Other endpoints return a plain array after the second parse.

CORS on the portal API allows any origin, so browser apps can call it directly, but then the
password goes from the browser straight to the portal. Never ship a shared server that stores passwords.

## Docs

- `src/README.md`: step-by-step usage with tested examples (web app, HTTP API, Python, JavaScript)
- `AGENTS.md`: rules for changing this repo, file map, recipes
- `docs/PORTAL_API.md`: every endpoint with observed field names
- `docs/BIOMETRIC.md`: campus biometric punch site (HTML, campus WiFi only)
- `README.md`: setup, routes, troubleshooting

## Rules

Read-only by default. Do not call payment, registration or other state-changing endpoints unless
the user asks. Never commit credentials, tokens or real responses. Do not poll or scrape other students.
